headline: Snacks at your door in ten minutes flat
body: Skip the grocery run. Get protein bars that actually taste good delivered right now with one-click ordering and free delivery perks on your regular restock.
rationale: This copy targets the Convenience-First Millennial by focusing heavily on instant fulfillment speed and frictionless one-click purchasing, aligning with their swiftcart delivery habits while entirely avoiding multi-step checkout friction.
